name: vast-titan
description: The 2x Titan RTX Vast.ai campaign: rent, stage, run the Strata matrix, pull, destroy.

estimate.basis: 2026-10-25 instance 57698991: 2.7 billed hours, $1.192 total at $0.311/h plus download

caveats: The historical host cost $0.311/h and $2.67/TB downloaded; the offer filter here rejects any host above $5/TB because a $53/TB host burned $3.80 on 73 GB.
The 131072 C=4 and 262144 C>=2 cells are skipped-infeasible: prefill ~1.5k tok/s and four concurrent prefills do not overlap four times.
Instance 57698991 was destroyed after the pull (DELETE success, list total 0); always run `benchctl vast destroy --instance ID --yes`.
The 2026-10-25 probe was the one-point calibration build and produced ~9% short prompts at >=131k; bench/probe.py is the two-point canonical version.
Vast /api/v0/instances/ is deprecated (301): list on /api/v1/instances/, create on PUT /api/v0/asks/{offer}/, destroy on DELETE /api/v0/instances/{id}/.
